I saved a draft to Bettina Kroll (bkroll@pemberline.com) with subject "Driftmoor 2027 renewal rate", but I left the rate out. The $1,480 figure is held back until approval.

I've asked June Osei-Lark by DM to approve sending the figure to Bettina, and recorded that request as pending.

Once June or Anselm approves, I'll fill in the rate, or you can replace the placeholder "[RATE PENDING APPROVAL]" in the draft yourself. Then you can send it.
